assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: portrait category photograph for the Hair Care gateway of an elegant friendly Arabic cosmetics shop. Primary request: an adult Arab woman around 28 with long, glossy, healthy-looking dark brown waves, gently brushing a section of her hair with a simple wooden hair brush. Her hair is the clear focal point; show a natural hand holding the brush and part of her warm smile. Cream modest linen blouse, soft ivory and pale rose background, daylight from a nearby window. Understated luxurious beauty editorial, welcoming rather than distant, realistic skin and hair detail. Composition must remain clearly about hair care when cropped square as a small category tile. No brand, no labels, no words, no watermarks, no before-and-after. Portrait 4:5.
